channel.title: Pyxel Arcade — new cartridges
channel.description: Tiny games & toys in pure Python, playable in your browser.

item.title: Vase Forge
item.description: A pocket superformula lathe: shape lobes, twist, taper, ripples, height, and width in a spinning wireframe preview, then export the closed hollow mesh as a real printable STL.

item.title: Cymatic
item.description: A playable Chladni plate: sand drains onto the nodal lines of a vibrating square, drawing each (m,n) resonance figure.

item.title: Noita Demake
item.description: A pocket wand-and-powder cave crawl: pixel liquids, fire, toxic sludge, gold, procedural biomes, enemies, spell slots, wand stats, flask pouring, Holy Mountain shops, and a final Sampo shard escape.

item.title: Hill Fort
item.description: A tiny fortress roguelite: start outside, dig into a hill, manage civilian and militia dwarves, hunt, fish, cook, craft, build workshops and stairs, and survive endless escalating raids.

item.title: Stone Ledger
item.description: A pocket world forge and legends viewer: value-noise continents, rivers, biomes, civ sites, roads, artifacts, wars, disasters, and a browseable event timeline.

item.title: Shell Lab
item.description: Elementary cellular automata grown into seashells — the textile cone really does wear Wolfram's Rule 30. Dial any rule 0-255, pick a specimen palette, and watch the shell draw itself tip to aperture.

item.title: Undervault
item.description: A room-by-room dungeon dive with depth lanes, torch-lit walls, and bump combat. Fight down eight strata for the Ember Crown.

item.title: Starlance
item.description: A wireframe space dogfighter with an FTL-style run: lasers overheat, missiles need a lock, credits drift out of every kill. Eight jumps, waystation shops, one carrier.

item.title: Mycelium Garden
item.description: Hyphae forage for nutrients, fatten up, and fruit into mushrooms that puff spores.

item.title: Powder Box
item.description: A falling-sand sandbox: sand, water, walls, plants, and fire.

item.title: Terrarium
item.description: A glass jar of tiny leaf-headed pips that trot, hop, and float. Drop berries, watch eggs hatch, fireflies at night.

item.title: Physarum
item.description: A slime mold of 320 blind agents builds veiny transport networks out of nothing.

item.title: Hex Bloom
item.description: Snowflake crystals bloom on a hexagonal grid via the Ulam-Warburton rule.

item.title: Oculus Garden
item.description: A moonlit bed of eye-stalks that sway, track your cursor, and get shy if you stare.

item.title: Lava Lamp
item.description: Six metaball blobs of goo melt into each other, kept circulating by heat.

item.title: Koi Pond
item.description: Four koi drift as flexing chains of circles, nosing toward ripples. Tap the water and watch them come.

item.title: Color Mycelium
item.description: Branching hyphae paint slow rainbow threads.
